caption: The drawing depicts a tall wooden grandfather clock with a rich reddish-brown finish. The clock stands upright and has a rectangular lower section with a door in the middle, above a wider, plinth-like base on four small feet. Above the main body is the clock face, which is set in a square case with a decorative arched top. The clock face itself is circular with a gold background and black Roman numerals. The center of the face has intricate scrolling patterns and a secondary, smaller circular dial. Above the main dial, within the arched section, is a moon phase indicator, illustrated by a yellow moon, a human face, white clouds, and a blue sky. The top of the clock is adorned with an ornamental finial and symmetrical, curved scrollwork on either side. The drawing is detailed and realistic, with careful shading to indicate depth and the wood grain. A ruler marking the scale runs vertically along the right edge, and the background is plain, off-white.
title: Grandfather Clock
